verdict.rationale: Docs confirm automatic grouping via error class, file and line number of the top in-project stack frame (bugsnag-docs-1), which is the core fingerprinting story, and automatic-assignment rules exist (bugsnag-docs-2) but this addresses issue routing, not grouping override. No evidence is provided of a documented way to override/customize the grouping fingerprint itself (e.g. custom grouping hash) or of hands-on validation that grouping works well at scale. Missing for 10: explicit customization/override mechanism for grouping, independent/hands-on evidence of grouping accuracy at high volume.
